SEC disclosures include 84,365,876 XRP purchased with cash and substantial contributed XRP from Ripple, Arrington XRP Capital Fund and a contributor related-party entity associated with the Larsen Lam Children's Remainder Trust, plus subscription XRP. The treasury balance is not equivalent to 473 million open-market purchases.
actual_or_completed_disclosures: SEC filings disclose $214.05 million cash and 600,000 XRP under advance funding agreements, plus a separate $10.5 million cash and 200,000 XRP delayed-funding line item.
The filings report 84,365,876 XRP purchased with cash; reconcile exact transaction timing, net cash and bank balances before estimating market impact.
Ripple contributed 126,791,458 XRP; Arrington XRP Capital Fund's subscription included approximately 211,319,096 XRP; a contributor related-party entity contributed 50 million XRP.

SBI-affiliated subscribers' Class A voting ownership is capped at 39.9%, with excess economic interest allocated to non-voting Class C; the filing also reports SBI-affiliated holders with 7.5% of Class C shares.

Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC, an Evernorth subsidiary, had borrowed $9.7 million under a Ripple-related $10 million facility as of 2026-10-07. This is related-party debt, not equity or an XRP spot purchase.
A $30 million convertible senior PIK note instrument appears in SEC filings; reconcile issuance, proceeds and current status before counting it as available cash.
contingent_financing: An October 23 equity line with CF Principal Investments LLC (Cantor affiliate) covers up to 5,218,935 shares and an illustrative maximum of about $80.7 million gross at the prospectus cover price; proceeds depend on actual share sales and conditions.
A warrant prospectus covers 11,499,992 shares at $11.50, implying up to about $132.2 million only if warrants are exercised for cash. Registration alone raises no cash.
